stable.label: matter-lab-0.5-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.5 is integrated after a fully green pull-request CI run. Overall product remains unverified because the live GitHub.io deployment and real iPhone Safari have not been independently exercised.

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.5 multi-particle topology tests

capabilities: reversible association between unlike generic species
explicit forward and reverse toy reaction events
internal transformed particle state on reacted associations
visible chains and branched clusters through the association renderer

active_objective: Turn the new graph topology into a more meaningful toy reaction network with explicit node/edge state categories and causal event history while preserving the playable 0.5 baseline.
next_gate: Add the next reaction-network capability on an isolated Lab branch; preserve the 0.5 topology and regression fixtures and do not describe toy graph rules as real chemistry.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Toy reaction events must not be described as validated chemistry
Toy topology valence limits must not be described as chemical valence
Particle state transformation must conserve particle count
